methods.label: Unit-work equation
methods.explanation: Let the time needed working together be \(x\) days, and take the total amount of work as 1. Then \((1/6+1/12)x=1\), or \((1/4)x=1\), so \(x=4\).
methods.levelReason: Normalizing the job to 1, adding fractional rates, and solving a simple equation fit Grade 7.
